summary: Israel continues intensified military operations in Gaza, with IDF and Shin Bet destroying five Hamas weapons warehouses and a launch site, including facilities established inside mosques and near humanitarian infrastructure. The IDF Chief of Staff visited Gaza reaffirming commitment to preventing enemy rearmament and continuing pursuit of October 7 attackers. US signals de-escalation by preparing to return diplomats to regional embassies while simultaneously imposing sweeping new sanctions on Iran, whose currency hit record lows. Golan Heights tensions escalate as Jolani's administration formally condemns the Israeli defense minister's presence there.
key_points: IDF and Shin Bet destroyed five Hamas weapons storage warehouses and one launch site in Gaza, with facilities located inside mosques and near humanitarian infrastructure, according to IDF statement (Source: @New_security8200/203434).

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir visited Gaza and stated the IDF will not allow enemies in Gaza and Lebanon to rebuild strength, pursuing all October 7 attackers until eliminated (Source: @New_security8200/203436).

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced new sanctions targeting 60 individuals, entities and ships linked to Iran, with ultimatum that financial institutions facilitating Iranian money laundering will be cut from dollar system (Source: @mamlekate/104234).
Iranian rial hit record 205,000 tomans per dollar, with gold coins reaching 224 million tomans, a nearly 10% weekly increase following new US sanctions package (Source: @VahidOnline/78031).
Trump administration preparing to return US diplomats to embassies in Israel, Lebanon, Jordan, Oman, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Iraq and Kuwait as early as this week (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6502).

Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated Israel will not move from Mount Hermon and security zone while jihadist threats against Israel persist, addressing message to Syrian president (Source: @naya_foriraq/88509).

Jolani's Foreign Ministry formally condemned Israeli Defense Minister's presence in the Golan Heights as illegal, in first formal response to escalating Israeli operations in Syria (Source: @SharghDaily/180049).

China's Foreign Ministry responded to US Iran sanctions stating Beijing-Tehran cooperation conducted under international law and will take all necessary measures to defend its rights (Source: @VahidOnline/78027).

sections.executive_summary: Israel maintains aggressive military posture across Gaza with ongoing strikes destroying Hamas weapons infrastructure while the IDF Chief of Staff publicly reaffirms commitment to eliminating October 7 attackers and preventing regional enemies from rebuilding. The US is signaling mixed signals through simultaneous military restraint by preparing to return diplomats to regional posts while escalating economic pressure with sweeping new sanctions targeting Iranian financial networks. Regional tensions expand as Jolani's administration formally condemns Israeli presence in the Golan Heights while Houthi leadership reaffirms commitment to armed resistance.

points: Iranian currency reached unprecedented levels, trading at 205,000 tomans per dollar on Tuesday, with gold coins at 224 million tomans, representing nearly 10% weekly decline following US announcement of new sanctions package targeting 60 individuals, entities and ships (Source: @VahidOnline/78031).

China's Foreign Ministry spokesperson Lin Jian stated that cooperation between Beijing and Tehran is conducted under international law and should not face interference, adding that China will take all necessary measures to defend its rights and interests while opposing unilateral US sanctions as illegal (Source: @VahidOnline/78027).

US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent announced that US Treasury, State and military teams are meeting global counterparts with clear expectations and timelines for halting Iranian-linked activities, warning that any institution facilitating Iranian money laundering will be cut from the US dollar system (Source: @mamlekate/104234).

Pakistan Interior Minister Mohsin Naqvi stated significant progress was made in talks with Iranian President Pezeshkian on steps for Tehran and Washington to restore an Islamabad memorandum of understanding (Source: @Faytuks_Network/6500).
Iran reportedly transmitted its positions and conditions regarding Egypt through Pakistani intermediaries as part of diplomatic contacts between Iran and the US (Source: @pkpoi/143742).

Iranian Vice President stated that Pakistani army commander's visit to Iran was very successful and achieved very important diplomatic results whose effects will become clear soon (Source: @pkpoi/143739).
US Secret Service confirmed awareness of a video appearing to threaten Trump's son that aired on Iranian state television, according to statement published Tuesday (Source: @VahidOnline/78028).

IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir visited Gaza and stated the IDF is prepared and alert on all fronts, will not allow enemies along borders, especially Gaza and Lebanon, to rebuild strength, and will continue offensive and systematic actions against terror infrastructure (Source: @New_security8200/203436).

Zamir declared the pursuit of October 7 terrorists continues, stating anyone who took part in the massacre will live under pursuit until eliminated, calling it a high-priority mission the Southern Command and entire IDF are committed to (Source: @manniefabian/59042).

IDF and Shin Bet attacked and destroyed five weapons storage warehouses and one launch site belonging to Hamas across multiple strikes in Gaza, with stores containing rockets, weapons, explosives, grenades and additional combat equipment (Source: @New_security8200/203434).

The IDF stated the destroyed warehouses were established inside mosques and alongside humanitarian infrastructure in Gaza, constituting cynical use of civilian facilities in violation of international law (Source: @New_security8200/203434).

Israeli Defense Minister Katz stated Israel will not move from Mount Hermon and the security zone as long as jihadist threats against Israel exist, addressing the Syrian president directly (Source: @naya_foriraq/88509).

Israeli commandos from the Duvdevan Unit arrested Palestinian Imam Hazem in Jenin this morning, son of Fathi Hazem who was killed attempting to stab troops last week; Hazem had expressed intentions to carry out terror attack following his father's death (Source: @manniefabian/59038).

Lavi Battalion forces in the Jordan Valley detained a Palestinian planning terror attack against Israeli civilians following night-long ambushes by Border Police and Samaria troops, seizing ten pistols (Source: @inon_yttach/9936).

Fathi's other son Raad Hazem is identified as terrorist who killed three Israelis in Tel Aviv in 2022 (Source: @manniefabian/59038).

IDF Chief of Staff Zamir specifically named Lebanon alongside Gaza as a border where enemies will not be allowed to rebuild strength, indicating ongoing operational focus on the northern front (Source: @New_security8200/203436).

sections.threat_assessment: The immediate threat picture shows Israel maintaining aggressive kinetic operations in Gaza while simultaneously expanding diplomatic pressure in the Golan Heights through the Defense Minister's visible presence. The IDF's destruction of Hamas weapons infrastructure and continued pursuit of October 7 attackers indicates Tel Aviv does not intend to accept any meaningful ceasefire constraints, with Southern Command explicitly stating forces will remove any immediate threats. The simultaneous US diplomatic return and sanctions escalation suggests a coordinated pressure-and-engagement strategy, with the Trump administration signaling it does not anticipate returning to active hostilities while demanding economic isolation of Iran. Jordan, Yemen and Lebanon-based threats remain active, with Eilat forces specifically preparing for multi-directional infiltration scenarios.
sections.regional_response: Regional actors are responding with calibrated diplomatic and military measures. Jolani's administration issued its first formal condemnation of Israeli actions in the Golan, establishing a pattern of verbal opposition without military escalation. China positioned itself as Tehran's economic defender, stating cooperation with Iran is conducted under international law while opposing unilateral sanctions as illegal. Pakistan is positioning itself as a mediator between Washington and Tehran, with significant progress reported on restoring bilateral agreements. The US return of diplomats to eight regional embassies signals confidence in de-escalation while maintaining military capabilities, with embassies in Israel and Kuwait specifically mentioned as part of the restoration plan.
sections.intelligence_notes: The combination of Israeli operations in Gaza and the Golan Heights, combined with US diplomatic returns and economic pressure on Iran, suggests coordinated US-Israel strategy combining military pressure with diplomatic normalization. Iran's economic crisis, evidenced by currency collapse exceeding 10% in one week, indicates sanctions are having measurable impact on regime stability. Pakistani mediation between Iran and the US appears to be producing tangible results, potentially involving Iranian concessions on nuclear and regional proxy activities. The Houthi leadership's public reaffirmation of armed resistance while domestic Iranian infrastructure crumbles suggests potential for asymmetric escalation from Yemen as Tehran's influence tools.
